name: weekly-report-generator
description: Weekly Report Generator & Team Dashboard - monorepo (NestJS API + Next.js web + shared types)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
